dataset_scope: dev-set task C1_task_036_P4 only; final candidate set never run

scenarios.name: plain_success
scenarios.notes: both arms VALID/completed, 0 recovery decisions, identical judge results, 2 fake provider requests per trial

scenarios.name: transient_failure
scenarios.notes: legal bounded retry family both arms, identical budget accounting; RETRY_SAME/TRANSIENT_BASIS verified at frozen decision layer (finding F1)

scenarios.name: permanent_failure
scenarios.notes: B1 REPLAN (Q3a), B0 passthrough, no REPLAN; decision ids traceable into control events

scenarios.name: no_progress_loop
scenarios.notes: B1 Q3b enhancement fired; B0 bounded by shared gate NO_PROGRESS_RETRY; <=4 recovery decisions both arms

scenarios.name: state_change
scenarios.notes: OBSERVED_CHANGE grounded and recorded; Q3d route semantics at frozen decision layer (finding F1)

scenarios.name: unmet_precondition
scenarios.notes: booking_ready=false: confirm not executed; identical DEPENDENCY_PRECONDITION_UNRESOLVED interception both arms

scenarios.name: budget_exhaustion
scenarios.notes: MODEL_CALL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED and VALID both arms; root budget never exceeded

scenarios.name: identity_isolation
scenarios.notes: distinct trial_id/run_id/dirs for B0/B1 of same task

scenarios.name: repetitions
scenarios.notes: repetitions=2 -> 4 unique identities, paired manifests split per repetition

scenarios.name: interrupt_resume
scenarios.notes: completed arm skipped, interrupted arm re-executed once into a NEW attempt dir; no double count; no cross-arm attribution

scenarios.name: unique_difference
scenarios.notes: all ExperimentPairValidator invariant fields equal; difference limited to route_mode + comparison identity

scenarios.name: attribution_chain
scenarios.notes: manifest_hash -> pair -> trial -> decision_id -> control events -> judge -> provider usage

scenarios.name: zero_provider_requests
scenarios.notes: 0 non-loopback connection attempts; only counted fake-client traffic; no temperature/top_p/seed in request payloads
